vivaSessions.topic: Design of Distributed Campus Microgrid Monitoring Architecture

turns.content: Welcome candidate. We have thoroughly reviewed your dissertation draft titled "Design of Distributed Campus Microgrid Monitoring Architecture" in Electrical & Electronic Engineering. Let us begin with your problem statement: Why did you decide that existing manual or conventional systems were inadequate, and what is the exact scientific or technical gap your proposed system bridges?
We utilized Modbus TCP/IP protocols interconnected with an edge Raspberry Pi MQTT broker to stream voltage telemetry every 500 milliseconds.
turns.feedback: Adequate defense point, but you need to elaborate on the engineering trade-offs and justify why your approach is superior to conventional alternatives.

turns.content: Thank you. Now, let us turn to Chapter 3 (Research Methodology). In your system for "Design of Distributed Campus Microgrid Monitoring Architecture", what sampling technique or dataset did you utilize for empirical validation, and how do you defend its statistical representation?

scorecard.summary: The candidate struggled to defend empirical sampling methodology and database transaction locking. Significant revisions recommended before final departmental sign-off.
